subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier`, and if so should existing no-override `bootstrap-extra-files` behavior remain unchanged for subagent and cron sessions?
rationale: The PR introduces a new public context-control knob and changes existing hook-extra bootstrap semantics, which is a product/API and upgrade-compatibility choice rather than a safe cleanup decision.

options.title: Preserve upgrade behavior before merge
options.body: Keep hook-loaded allowlisted extras in the no-override path, apply root-only filtering only to explicit lean tiers, and document the new tier contract.

options.title: Accept full-tier-only hook extras
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally require users to set `bootstrapTier: "full"` for hook extras, but the PR should include explicit upgrade documentation and tests for that break.

options.title: Close pending alternate design
options.body: If maintainers prefer a different context-control model, close this PR and keep the linked proposal as the product discussion.

recommendation.title: Preserve upgrade behavior before merge
recommendation.body: Keep hook-loaded allowlisted extras in the no-override path, apply root-only filtering only to explicit lean tiers, and document the new tier contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the original subagent bootstrap limiting behavior and already gave the visible maintainer-side review that this PR needs product/API review.
